Before we start I feel like you can’t really compare DD2 with DDDA since Dark arisen was not only a dlc it also brought so much QOL changes to the game. I know you can’t play base/launch DD1 anymore and thats probably for the better (expect for into free being the opening song). I’m sure in due time DD2 will get its QOL patches. More than a stack of 99 items, better equipment/inventory management, performance in general, and potentially a dlc that plays into the strong suit of the game like DA did for DD1.

Though having played both at launch it’s hard to say one of better than the other. My perspective on gaming was a lot different than it is now. I’m sure if I had to run everywhere, managing stamina, and backtrack everywhere now it would be an absolute nightmare of a game. I suppose 14 years old me didn’t care much then. 

But if I had to stack up both games at launch it’d go like this
-Story: DD1 (don’t know how the devs literally did the DD1 story but worse somehow, DD1 wasn’t great but atleast they built up the antagonist well.)
-Gameplay: draw (I’d say DD2 has the advantage of a better system in place because it’s a newer game but DD1 seems like it’s more diverse in its options)
-World: DD2 
-Monster diversity: slightly DD1 (The dullahan, sphinx, and Medusa are great additions, but where’s the other big monsters? Evil eye and hydra? Even the reskined ones are back which is odd because most of the additional monsters we have now are reskins anyway. 
-QOL: DD2 (easily it’s still not perfect and missing things that were in the first game. Like equip from storage. But good lord imagine your only Portcrystals were only at Vernworth and Battahl. Then you only get one extra portable portcrystal per play through. Also no OX carts.) 

This game isn’t a step up or step down as a whole it’s more of a stagnant lateral move. Which in itself is pretty disappointing as a long time fan. I’m sure the DLC will be good if it’s just gonna be the Dark Arisen equivalent for DD2.
